properties.description: Attractive three bedroom semi-detached family home situated within 0.5 miles of Petts Wood station with fast trains to London and within easy walking distance of local shops, schools, bus routes and National Trust woodland. The property comprises; two receptions, fitted 18'9 x 10'1 kitchen/breakfast room and conservatory. The property also benefits from having a utility room and cloakroom. To the first floor there are three bedrooms and a family bathroom with separate WC. Additional features include double glazing, gas central heating and a well presented interior...
properties.location: Petts Wood Road, Petts Wood, Orpington BR5

properties.description: Presented in excellent decorative order throughout is this two double bedroom, two bathroom, garden flat. The modern fitted kitchen is open plan to the living room which boasts solid wooden floors and includes integrated appliances including a dishwasher & a washing machine. This large open plan benefits from bi folding doors onto a secluded private courtyard garden. Both bedrooms are double sized, and the family bathroom boasts a matching three piece suite a shower attachment over the bath. There is also a separate wet room. There are walnut doors throughout and wiring for Sky TV/aerial points in the living room/kitchen and both bedrooms.This apartment being only five years old, is still under a 10 year building guarantee...

Spacious four bedroom detached family home located in a quiet residential area. The property features a large open-plan kitchen and dining area, a separate living room, a utility room and a downstairs WC. Upstairs offers four generous bedrooms including a master bedroom with en-suite bathroom. The property benefits from a private rear garden and off-street parking.

Modern one bedroom apartment situated on the third floor of a well-maintained development. The property comprises an open-plan living and kitchen area with integrated appliances, a double bedroom with built-in wardrobes, and a contemporary bathroom. Ideal for first-time buyers or investors, with excellent transport links nearby.

Charming two bedroom terraced house located within walking distance of local shops and public transport. The property offers a bright reception room, a fitted kitchen, and a family bathroom. To the rear is a low-maintenance garden. This home is perfect for young professionals or small families.

Luxury three bedroom apartment offering stunning city views. The property features a spacious living area with floor-to-ceiling windows, a modern kitchen with high-end appliances, and three well-sized bedrooms. Residents benefit from secure entry, lift access, and a concierge service.

Exceptional five bedroom executive home located in an exclusive gated development. The property boasts multiple reception rooms, a high-spec kitchen, a cinema room, and landscaped gardens. Upstairs includes five double bedrooms, two with en-suite bathrooms. Ideal for luxury family living.
